name: learning
description: Adaptive teaching, concept rebuilding and practice with persistent learner evidence and optional Kasten integration.

interface.shortDescription: Learn, practice and retain evidence of understanding
interface.longDescription: Teach and quiz a topic or session, rebuild a concept, survey blind spots, and practice prior learning with varied cues. Portable session records preserve learner models, hints and independent performance, with optional Kasten storage.
defaultPrompt: Quiz me on what we just did this session
Teach me about Kafka consumer groups and test my understanding
Make sure I actually understand the change we just made
Practice attention from my previous learning record using new situations
